purpose: AMT liability from an ISO exercise spread using the 2026 exemption amounts and phase-out thresholds, ported from ApexLogics Apex #109 (AL-116). For shares, strike price, FMV at exercise, ordinary income, other AMT preference items and a single/mfj filing status, the node computes the ISO spread (an AMT preference under IRC sec. 56(b)(3)), AMTI, the phased-out exemption (90100/140200 reduced by 50 percent above 500000/1000000 per IRC sec. 55(d)(4)(A)(ii), which overrides sec. 55(d)(2)'s 25 percent base rate for tax years beginning after Dec. 31, 2025), tentative minimum tax at 26/28 percent split at the 244500 breakpoint, the regular-tax comparison over the 2026 Rev. Proc. 2025-32 brackets, the AMT owed as the excess of TMT over regular tax, the credit generated, the maximum shares exercisable without triggering AMT (fixed 60-iteration binary search over 0..shares x 10) and a 5-step exercise-quantity scenario ladder. Unknown filing_status or a non-finite input is refused with a named code, never a silent guess. Apex folds MFS into its single option and models the credit as the full AMT owed; both are Apex-value-kept report items (payload DIFFERS.md D2, D6), flagged in the kernel, never silently diverged.
